title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the importance of properly assimilating Dharma, wealth, food, a Guru's teachings, and medicine
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting that righteous conduct, honest wealth, food, a Guru's guidance, and health knowledge must be properly understood and put into practice to yield their intended benefits in life. The Prime Minister wrote on X; "धर्मं धनं च धान्यं च गुरोर्वचनमौषधम्। सुगृहीतं च कर्तव्यमन्यथा तु न जीवति॥" Dharma—that is, righteous conduct and spiritual merit; wealth—that is, money earned honestly; grain—that is, a store of food; the Guru's words—that is, the teachings and guidance imparted by the Guru; and medicine—that is, medicines and knowledge related to health—all these should be properly received, understood, assimilated, and put into practice. If they are not used appropriately, they will fail to yield their intended benefits in life. धर्मं धनं च धान्यं च गुरोर्वचनमौषधम्।

सुगृहीतं च कर्तव्यमन्यथा तु न जीवति॥ https://t.co/p846QS4tGl — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 13, 2026 ***** MJPS/SS/PRK
